# Psalm 102 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 102:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-prayer of-the-afflicted when-he-faints and-before YHWH pours-out his-complaint.
- **LOGOS:** A prayer of one afflicted, when he is faint and pours out his complaint before the LORD.
- **PNEUMA:** A prayer of someone suffering, overwhelmed, pouring out their troubles before the LORD.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 102:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Do-not hide your-face from-me in-day-of my-distress; incline to-me your-ear; in-day I-call answer-me quickly.
- **LOGOS:** Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress! Incline your ear to me; answer me speedily in the day when I call!
- **PNEUMA:** Don't turn away from me when I'm in trouble! Listen closely — when I call, answer me right away!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 102:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Is-struck like-grass and-withered my-heart, for I-forget to-eat my-bread.
- **LOGOS:** My heart is struck down like grass and has withered; I forget to eat my bread.
- **PNEUMA:** My heart has been beaten down and dried up like dead grass — I even forget to eat.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 102:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** From-voice-of my-groaning has-clung my-bone to-my-flesh.
- **LOGOS:** Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
- **PNEUMA:** I groan so much that I'm nothing but skin and bones.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 102:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-am-like a-pelican-of the-wilderness; I-have-become like-an-owl-of ruins.
- **LOGOS:** I am like a desert owl of the wilderness, like an owl of the waste places;
- **PNEUMA:** I'm like a lonely desert bird, like an owl sitting in the ruins.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 102:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Because-of your-indignation and-your-wrath, for you-have-lifted-me-up and-you-have-cast-me-away.
- **LOGOS:** because of your indignation and anger; for you have taken me up and thrown me down.
- **PNEUMA:** because of your fury and anger — you picked me up and threw me aside.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
